text:
Ivy: hey team — first day! stuck on Okta SSO. it keeps asking me to register a passkey but when i try it fails with 'platform authenticator unavailable'. also can't access eng-shared drive and the 1Password invite seems assigned to a different email. any pointers?

Jordan (IT): welcome Ivy! :wave: which machine/os and are you using the company Wi-Fi? sometimes corporate wifi throws a proxy cert that interferes with passkey registration.

Ivy: macOS Sonoma 14, company wifi at the office. i tried both Safari and Chrome. passkey flow opens a modal then says 'platform authenticator unavailable' after I confirm. 1Password invite came to ivy.personal@gmail.com instead of ivy@redwood.dev.

it-ops-bot: ticket ONB-4092 created for okta-passkey-fail + 1p-invite-misassign. Assigned to Jordan (IT). ETA 90m.

Ethan (Infra): tagging in infra — can you try disabling the office wifi (use phone hotspot) to see if the passkey prompt works off-network? also send me a screenshot of the browser console errors if it still fails.

Ivy: switched to phone hotspot, tried passkey again in Safari — now it proceeds but after biometric it errors with 'unable to store credential'. console shows: "DOMException: The operation is insecure."

Jordan (IT): that suggests the site isn't fully on a secure context for passkey storage — could be a redirect or cookie setting. i'm going to re-provision your Okta account's auth factors and resend the 1Password invite to your corporate email.

1Password-bot: 1Password invite resent to ivy@redwood.dev (item: Redwood - New Hire Seat).

Ivy: got the 1Password invite at the corporate email, accepted. thanks!

Ethan (Infra): quick check: do you have any privacy extensions or strict Intentionally Block Third-Party Cookies settings? passkeys require same-site context for the relying party. Also confirm system privacy settings allow Safari to use Touch ID for websites (System Settings > Touch ID & Passwords).

Ivy: no extensions installed. Touch ID shows enabled for Safari. i ran a quick `dscacheutil -flushcache` and tried again — still the same 'unable to store credential' when on hotspot (but the initial biometric prompt shows).

Jordan (IT): i'm going to escalate to Okta support from our tenant side; in the meantime Ethan, any chance our load balancer adds a header that breaks secure cookies for some clients?

Ethan (Infra): possible — we had a recent edge proxy tweak. i'll check logs for your IP and the timestamp, and roll back a recent config if needed. Can you try an incognito/private window and attempt passkey registration one more time? Incognito avoids some cookie interactions that might be interfering.

Ivy: incognito on Chrome — it worked! Passkey registered successfully and Okta accepted it. Now i can see eng-shared drive. Looks like a cookie/config interaction.

Jordan (IT): great news. i'll annotate ONB-4092: resolved for Ivy by using incognito + Okta reprovision and 1Password invite fixed. Ethan, please follow up on proxy cookie flags to prevent regressions for other new hires.

Ethan (Infra): noted — investigating LB cookie SameSite settings and will revert the change if needed. Also adding an onboarding note: if passkey registration fails, try private browsing or hotspot as a quick workaround.

Lina (People Ops): welcome Ivy! added you to the new hires lunch at noon and to the onboarding checklist. let us know if any other access gaps pop up.

Ivy: huge thanks everyone, that got me fully set up. excited to be here! :tada:
